links.title: The Official eVisa website for Indonesia

docs.text: Visa request letter from the Indonesian spouse (sponsor applies via evisa.imigrasi.go.id)
Passport valid for at least 6 months (12 months for non-national travel documents)
Recent colour photograph (taken within the last year)
Proof of living costs: bank statement of the last 3 months (applicant or sponsor), minimum USD 2,000 or equivalent
Itinerary
Curriculum vitae
Marriage abroad: proof of registration with the Indonesian mission or civil registry, and marriage certificate translated into Indonesian by a sworn translator (unless in English)
Marriage in Indonesia: marriage book or certificate issued by the competent ministry or institution
Stay 1 or 2 years, extendable

Visa-free (A1): 30 days, not extendable; passport valid 6 months and return/onward ticket
Arrival card must be submitted within 3 days before arrival
